decisions.reason: The architectural label describes a style exemplified by Larabanga Mosque; no distinct place is identified by the listing.
The Assembly identifies the Memorial Wall of Return within the Ancestral Slave River Park.
The Assembly identifies the Ancestral Graveyard as part of the same River Park.
